name: The Life (and Deaths) of Doctor M
author: Michael D. Hilborn; interpreter: Glulxe + CheapGlk
description: You land in an endless, windy landscape and piece together the life of a mad scientist. Text adventure in English (Michael D. Hilborn, 2011). Non-commercial licence. Type if-doctor-m in the Terminal or tap the icon.
